evidence: Modifies settings and argument error handling during node startup initialization.
rationale: Prevents `std::terminate` crash during startup when `settings.json` contains invalid `dbcache` values, allowing a clean diagnostic exit. When `GetIntArg` throws `std::runtime_error` on malformed settings, the `noexcept` marker on `LogOversizedDbCache` forced an abrupt termination instead of propagating the error to `AppInit`.
